internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service Elevated Error Rate Due to Dependency Unreachable
internal.body:
At 11:29 UTC, an alert was triggered for the cart service due to a high error rate. Diagnosis identified the root cause as a dependency unreachable issue related to 'Valkey connection error'. The error rate in the cart service was elevated at 0.12, with some latency increase but not critical. Actions were taken to disable the cartFailure flag at 11:49 UTC after approval, which led to recovery and normalization of error rates to 0.002. The incident was resolved promptly with no further impact.

Timeline:
- 11:29:42 Alert received for cart service error rate
- 11:49:24 Diagnosis confirmed dependency unreachable issue
- 11:49:31 Flag cartFailure disabled after approval
- 11:49:31 Recovery verified with normalized error rates

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.title: Intermittent Cart Service Errors Resolved
external.body: Between 11:29 and 11:49 UTC, some customers experienced intermittent errors when using the cart service. This was due to a temporary issue with a service dependency. The issue was identified and resolved quickly, and normal service has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
